cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your caretaker interview, apologise to the chair. We practised asking permission; you sat without waiting for its answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then use the apology opening I taught you: 'I'm sorry I mistook your silence for permission.' To the chair, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly. Now apologise for taking away its job. You used to fix one person's problem by forgetting the other person's feelings too.

reason: Let remembered practical training shape witness discipline, apology, approval, impossible delegation or genuine discovery. Keep the impossible premise coherent and avoid treating every teacher as pretending omniscience.
